name: Drop sprinkle sugar cookies
description: Soft, buttery vanilla sugar cookies packed with sprinkles. No rolling or cutting, just scoop, chill and bake.
steps: Whisk the [flour](@flour), [baking powder](@baking-powder) and [salt](@salt) in a medium bowl. Set aside.

Beat the [butter](@butter) and [sugar](@sugar) on medium-high for about 1 minute, until creamy. Add the [egg](@egg) and [vanilla](@vanilla) and beat on high for about 1 minute, scraping the bowl as needed.
Add the dry ingredients and mix on low until combined. Stir in the [sprinkles](@sprinkles). The dough will be thick and sticky.
Roll 2 tablespoon (40 g) balls of dough. Dip the tops in [extra sprinkles](@topping-sprinkles) if you like, and set them on a plate or lined sheet.
Cover and chill the dough balls for at least 2 hours, up to 4 days.
Heat the oven to 350°F and line baking sheets with parchment or silicone mats.
Set the cold dough balls 3 inches apart. Bake 12 to 13 minutes, until the edges are lightly browned. The centers will look very soft.
Cool 5 minutes on the sheet, then move to a rack to cool completely.
tips: Don't skip the chill. It stops the cookies from spreading too much.
Roll the dough into balls before chilling, because it gets hard after a couple of hours in the fridge.
Any sprinkles work except nonpareils, which can bleed color into the dough. Leave them out for plain sugar cookies.
A little almond extract adds extra flavor.
Dough balls freeze for up to 3 months. Bake from frozen and add about a minute.
Keeps covered at room temperature for up to a week.
